reason: In src/sentry/integrations/mixins/issues.py:389-390, should_sync returns False whenever sync_source.integration_id equals the target org_integration.integration_id. sync_group_assignee_inbound (src/sentry/integrations/utils/sync.py:96-116) tags every inbound change with only the integration ID, and sync_group_assignee_outbound (sync.py:131-145) sends it to every linked external issue. So a second issue on the same integration that is linked to the same group no longer gets the assignee, although it did before the patch.
